summary: New box Part. Pass.: example for sense 1 in Part. Pass. (94/104)
rationale: First II Detransitive Part. Pass. example: predicative mlawḏo with fyš and an explicit grain subject. Retain the edition's dynamic German rendering.
94/104 has grain as patient-subject of kofoyəš mlawḏo, with no heaping agent; one clear result-state attestation. This introduces Detransitive numbering independently of active II.1.

summary: II Infectum komlawḏila at 94/91 is transitive, with a suffixed theme and workers as understood agents; it is already quoted. Literal ʕal ḥḏoḏe and distributive i ǧəhke b ǧəhke describe how the crop is heaped, without a distinct idiom.

94/104 presents mlawḏo as a result-state predicate with fyš; grain is the affected subject and no external agent is expressed. File as Detransitive Part. Pass. provisionally, rather than inferring an unattested finite Detransitive paradigm.
Neither occurrence supplies a III example. Preserve inherited III malwaḏle/malwəḏ and its (examples?) question without inventing evidence.
Confirm whether predicative mlawḏo at 94/104 is productively the II Part. Pass. or a lexical adjective; no finite Detransitive forms are inferred.
